status: Exploratory post-results analysis; not external preregistration
centroid_rule: Frozen full-resolution geometric tract centroid in EPSG5070
point_rule: All frozen amenity=cafe records after original cross-type duplicate removal, including adjacent and excluded tracts
exposure_rule: log2(1 + number of mapped cafes within fixed centroid radius); fixed-radius count, no resident-population denominator
model_rule: Primary eight context terms + county fixed effects, equal tract weight; alternative adds log2(1 + noncafe hospitality within same radius)
inference: CR1 county sandwich with original full design rank and t49; conditional on PLACES point estimates
cv_rule: Reuse original 20 km grid five-fold assignments; remove training centroids <= 1 km from any held-out centroid, across all counties; no tuning; reproduce baseline original folds first.
county_slopes: Exploratory descriptions only; no county significance claims
limitations: Proximity is centroid-based planar distance, not walking network or individual access
Frozen establishment inventory is not a field-verified business census
No source uncertainty propagation, independent observed health validation, or causal effects
secondary_independent_checks: All-pairs projected-distance enumeration; WGS84 geodesic threshold sensitivity; geodesic extraction-bound coverage; source record origin inventory.

sources.title: Roberts et al. 2017 Cross-validation strategies for data with temporal, spatial, hierarchical, or phylogenetic structure
Kwan 2012 The uncertain geographic context problem
